identification: Framed watercolour of fairies blowing bubbles on a lakeshore, signed J Skerratt; probably Jean Skerratt, a painter whose watercolours and oils (Upper Derwent, New Harbour South Coast) have sold through Gowans

entries.note: Framed painting of a fairy wren by Dianne Mathews with certificate. Not a fairy picture and a different artist; only shows what a modest signed framed decorative painting makes in the Hobart room. Hammer, premium extra. Seen via the local database and Gowans API, no page opened.

Genuine Ida Rentoul Outhwaite watercolour. NOT comparable to an unknown J Skerratt; shown only to mark the ceiling if the style were mistaken for the real thing, which it is not. From the local comps database, page not opened.
